name: PD 290 was established by Ordinance No. 19880, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 9,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 290 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 290 was established by Ordinance No. 19880, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 9, 1988. Ordinance No. 19880 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 290 is established on property generally located along the southwest line of Riek Road, southeast of the southeast line of Ferguson Road. The size of PD 290 is approximately 1.47 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 290A). (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.105. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. Landscaping must be installed within one year of the date of issuance of a building permit for construction of the driveway shown on the development plan. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.106. USES.

(a) Use of the Property is limited to the following:

(1) Parking for the bank or savings and loan use on the adjacent property.

(2) Accessory storage building for the bank or savings and loan use on the adjacent property.

(3) Sale and display of automobiles six times each year during the weekend between 8:00 a.m. Friday and 8:00 p.m. Saturday.

(b) The servicing or repair of automobiles is prohibited on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.107. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum floor area for the utility storage facility shown on the development plan is 2,400 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.108. HEIGHT.

Maximum structure height on the Property is 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.109. SETBACKS.

(a) The following setbacks must be provided on the Property:

Yard Setback Required

Front 12 feet Side 15 feet Rear 10 feet

(b) Parking is prohibited within the front yard area. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.110. OFF-STREET PARKING.

A maximum of 112 parking spaces are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Notification Of Weekend Sale
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.111. NOTIFICATION OF WEEKEND SALE.

Fourteen days prior to the weekend sale and display of automobiles on the Property, the owner must submit a letter to the director of code compliance stating the date of the sale. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Removal Of Cars
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.112. REMOVAL OF CARS.

All cars displayed on the Property during a weekend sale must be removed from the Property by 8:00 a.m. on the Monday following the sale. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Lighting Of The Parking Lot Prohibited
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.113. LIGHTING OF THE PARKING LOT PROHIBITED.

Free-standing lighting fixtures are prohibited on the Property. Lights placed on the accessory storage building for the purpose of illuminated the parking lot are prohibited. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.114. SIGNS.

All signs must meet the requirements for non-business districts contained in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.116. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-290.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 290 is located on Zoning Map No. J-9. (Ord. Nos. 19880; 25711)
